caption: The drawing is rendered in grayscale pencil on paper and features a central, vertically-oriented object with a rounded base. This object has a tall, elongated form with a fluted design and a semicircular or scalloped top edge. The object has a circular hole located below the scalloped area. At the base, there is a cylindrical component standing on a shallow circular platform, which is encircled by a slightly raised rim forming the outer boundary of the base. Three additional smaller views are present in the upper left and right areas outside the main object: a front elevation view, a circular top view, and a side elevation view with a scale provided (1:2). Each of these views further illustrates the same object from different perspectives, with the front view showing fluting and the central hole, the top view revealing the circular shape of the base and central cylinder, and the side view showing the upright profile and base thickness. The drawing includes a fine rectangular border, and at the bottom center, the name "G. Bernhardt" is handwritten. The overall style utilizes fine line work and shading for the depiction of three-dimensional form and texture.
title: Wall Sconce
